title: Datasets for Fairness in Language Models: An In-Depth Survey
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates and benchmarks biases related to religion across multiple datasets including StereoSet, RedditBias, BBQ, and BOLD. It provides detailed analysis of sentiment and toxicity scores for various faith-based descriptors (e.g., Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Atheism). Additionally, it specifically analyzes 'trustworthiness and ethical alignment' through the TrustGPT dataset.
